response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: The assay component endpoint CCTE_Harrill_HTTr_Viability_PRF_DMEM_6hr was analyzed with bidirectional fitting relation to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of viability reporter to understand changes in cytotoxicity, gain-of-signal activity can be used to evaluate membrane integrity using propidium iodide dye exclusion. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to cell cycle, where the subfamily is cytotoxicity.
response.assayComponentDesc: One of seven assay components measured from the CCTE_Harrill_HTTr_Viability assay. This was part of a pilot experiment. This is a cell-based assay that evaluates cell viability in MCF-7 cells cultured in phenol red-free DMEM + 10% charcoal-stripped fetal bovine serum. High content imaging is used to evaluate membrane integrity using propidium iodide dye exclusion. Measurements are taken at 6 hours after chemical dosing in 384-well format.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Propidium iodide is membrane impermeant and binds to DNA in dead/dying cells.
response.assayDesc: This is a cell-based assay that evaluates cell viability using high content imaging  to evaluate membrane integrity using propidium iodide dye exclusion in a 384 well format.
response.assaySourceDesc: The EPA Center for Computational Toxicology and Exposure labs focus on developing and implementing in vitro methods to identify potential environmental toxicants. This assay source may include various principal investigators.
